data.name: Dulal
data.gender_notes: Dulal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who radiates brightness and light. The name Dulal carries the meaning “Brightness, Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Dulal usually hope their child will grow to embody brightness, light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who bring light and positivity to others.
data.etymology: Dulal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brightness, Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dulal total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: دُلال
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على المبالغة في الدلال والتمنيع
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني المبالغة في الدلال والتمنيع، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الحجر آية 47: 'وَلَئِن فَتَحنا عَلَيْهِم بَاباً مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَجَآءَهُم بِالشَّيْءِ الَّذِي كُنتُوا بِهِ يُكَذِّبُونَ'، وقد أُطلق على بعض الصحابة اسم دُلال و الدلال هو التزين والتجميل

in_urdu.name: دُلال
in_urdu.meaning: دلال کا نام، مبالغہ کار، خوبصورت بنانے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: دُلال ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے مبالغہ کار یا خوبصورت بنانے والا، یہ نام بعض صحابیوں پر بھی رکھا گیا تھا، جیسے کہ دُلال بن أبي دُلال العبدري، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں بھی مقبول ہے

in_hindi.name: दुलाल
in_hindi.meaning: दुलाल का अर्थ है आकर्षक, मोहक, प्रिय
in_hindi.long_meaning: दुलाल एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है आकर्षक या मोहक, यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है और अक्सर बच्चों को दिया जाता है, भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी यह नाम बहुत लोकप्रिय है

in_pashto.name: دولال
in_pashto.meaning: دولال د ښکلا او جمال معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: دولال په عربي ژبه کې د مبالغې او ښکلا معنی لري، دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو کې هم مشهور دی، په پښتو کې دولال د هغې سړي لپاره کارول کيږي کوم چې ډېر ښکلی او جمیل دی

in_english.name: Dulal
in_english.long_meaning: The name Dulal originates from Arabic roots, specifically from the word 'dalal' which means to beautify or to make something desirable. In Islamic tradition, Dulal signifies someone who brings joy and beauty. Historically, it was used to describe someone endearing or charming. The name holds spiritual significance in being a reflection of inner and outer beauty.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Dulal is a reminder of the inner light and radiance that is present within every human being, emphasizing the importance of nurturing this light to illuminate the path towards righteousness and self-improvement. It serves as a reminder of the connection between the Divine light of Allah and the human spirit, illuminating the way towards spiritual growth and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Brightness, Light" symbolizes One who radiates brightness and light.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Dulal serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of brightness, light.
